title: Health Financing & Advocacy
description: BIRCH/ Health Financing and Advocacy builds on the work that LMH has been implementing Iin collaboration with the Ministry of Health to ascertain the needs and gaps for the community health program in Malawi. The proejct aims to build the foundational systems components for community health; Improve the existing and future financial health of this critical pillar of government health agenda(s) and strengthening implementation of GC7 community health investments.

title: iCHIS/Upskill
description: LMH has partnered with MoH and other implementing partners (UNIMA, UNICEF, USAID (AMREF,PALLADIUM,D-TREE), WANDIKWEZA, SAVE THE CHILDREN, PARTNERS IN HEALTH, DIABETIS CAMPUS, PMI EVOLVE, GLOBAL FUND) to design, develop and roll-out the integrated community health infromation system (iCHIS: a point of care application (built on DHIS2 tracker) that strengthens community health service delivery) in Malawi by 2030.
